name: micro_pipe
description: Microbenchmarks: fetch/ALU, branches and jumps, L1 load/store hits, load-use, CSR access (cycles per operation)
expect: MICRO CHECK OK micro_pipe iterations={iterations} regions=26
units: operations per region (cycles/iter = cycles per operation)

region_ops.1: region overhead: call + return of an empty kernel (cycles/iter is not per-op)
region_ops.2: one trip of a bare loop: addi + taken bnez
region_ops.3: add (32-bit), each dependent on the previous
region_ops.5: c.add (16-bit), dependent; two per fetch word
region_ops.6: add (32-bit), dependent, every one straddling two fetch words
region_ops.10: jal ra to a callee + its addi + ret
region_ops.11: jalr ra to a callee + its addi + ret
region_ops.12: data-dependent beqz to the next instruction, never taken: andi + srli + add + beqz, plus 1/8 of ld + addi
region_ops.14: as brpat_never, alternating taken / not taken
region_ops.15: as brpat_never, random order with exactly half taken
region_ops.16: ld hitting L1, dependent chain (load-to-load latency)
region_ops.17: ld hitting L1, independent, no consumer
